Claim 1 (currently amended): An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, __only__ compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use.

Claim 5 (currently amended): The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by __rotary__ binary actuators.

Claim 7 (currently amended): An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds __to adjust braking force based thereon__. 

Claim 8 (currently amended): An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors, and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to __adaptively__ control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed.
